claims.claim: You can apply for Discretionary Support online.
claims.quote: you can apply for Discretionary Support, a Short Term Benefit Advance or Universal Credit New Claims Grant via the online application form
claims.note: The Finance Support page explicitly gives an online application route.

claims.claim: You can apply for Discretionary Support by phone.
claims.note: The page lists a telephone contact and says someone will contact online applicants, but never says a phone call starts an application.
